pages.title: Making Hepatizon
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)1 Infuscolium + 1 Steel = 2 Hepatizon

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 761 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 3.$(br)Mining efficiency: 7.2.$(br)Material damage bonus: 4.2.$(br)Enchantability: 29.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 4, leggings 4, boots 3.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 1.0.$(br)Enchantability: 29.

pages.title: Weapon: Disarm
pages.text: When attacking you have a chance to rob the enemy of some of their equipment.

pages.title: Armor: Cloak & Dagger
pages.text: Grants AI invisibility outside of a certain radius depending on how much armor you're wearing.
